# webular

> A web research CLI on Bun. Its judgment calls go to Jev, TypeSafe's System One decision model. It scrapes, crawls, maps, extracts, searches, and summarizes with free and open-source parts, as Mastra workflows built on Effect and XState and run from a fixed mise task graph.

Jev's key (`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`) is the only API key. Without it, each decision falls back to a rule-based baseline, and `WEBULAR_JEV=off` turns Jev off. Start at the README, then the docs and benchmark pages below.

## Install

- [docs/install.md](https://github.com/srinitude/webular/blob/main/docs/install.md): npm `webular`, Homebrew `srinitude/webular/webular`, Scoop bucket `srinitude/scoop-webular` with package `webular`, winget `Srinitude.Webular`, and GitHub release assets.
- [docs/install-script.md](https://github.com/srinitude/webular/blob/main/docs/install-script.md): one command that installs and verifies, `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://webular.dev/install.sh | sh` (it checks the SHA-256 before it installs), with every option.
- [docs/install-more.md](https://github.com/srinitude/webular/blob/main/docs/install-more.md): mise, eget, release file checks, upgrade, and uninstall.
